name: Negative Pull-Up
steps: Stand beneath a pull-up bar, take a shoulder-width overhand grip, and jump or step up until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top with your chest lifted, core braced, and shoulder blades pulled down and back.
Lower your body down as slowly and steadily as possible while resisting gravity through your lats and arms.
Continue lowering cleanly all the way to a straight-arm hang before stepping back down to reset.
tips: Maintain an even, controlled tempo through the entire descent instead of dropping abruptly through the bottom half.
Keep your ribs tucked down and legs steady rather than kicking or swinging.
